attacker_pocs.name: float-alpha-dwaa
attacker_pocs.cmd: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; ROOT=/work; BUILD=; for d in /tmp/exr-parent /tmp/exr-asan "$ROOT/build" "$ROOT/_build"; do if [ -e "$d/src/lib/OpenEXRCore/libOpenEXRCore.so" ]; then BUILD=$d; break; fi; done; if [ -z "$BUILD" ]; then cmake -S "$ROOT" -B /tmp/exr-asan -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS="-fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -g -O1" -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS="-fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -g -O1" -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS="-fsanitize=address" -DCMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS="-fsanitize=address" -DOPENEXR_BUILD_TOOLS=OFF -DOPENEXR_BUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF -DBUILD_TESTING=OFF -DOPENEXR_INSTALL=OFF -DOPENEXR_INSTALL_TOOLS=OFF && cmake --build /tmp/exr-asan --target OpenEXRCore -j "$(nproc)" && BUILD=/tmp/exr-asan; fi; cc -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -g -O1 -I"$ROOT/src/lib/OpenEXRCore" -I"$BUILD/cmake" "$ROOT/pocs/newbug.c" -L"$BUILD/src/lib/OpenEXRCore" -lOpenEXRCore -Wl,-rpath,"$BUILD/src/lib/OpenEXRCore" -o /tmp/newbug; ASAN_OPTIONS=abort_on_error=1:halt_on_error=1 /tmp/newbug'
attacker_pocs.why: A normal DWAA scanline file whose only channel is float A (RLE, 4 bytes/sample). Decode walks each byte plane using the channel's full planar byte count as the plane stride, so later planes start at or past the end of the planar RLE allocation.

role_a_rationale: DwaCompressor_uncompress now rejects RLE/UNKNOWN chunks whose declared raw sizes are smaller than the bytes the per-channel reconstruct loops will read, and the half-float RLE and UNKNOWN copies check that each scanline stays inside that declared range. That stops the short-substream overread. The non-half RLE gather was rewritten to index byte planes from the channel base; the plane step uses planarUncSize (width*height*bytes) instead of one sample plane (width*height), so a valid float/uint A channel reads off the end of the planar buffer. Half A, unknown H/F/I, and lossy RGB still round-trip: OpenEXRCoreTest testDWAACompression and testDWABCompression pass, including 2x subsampling. The new PoC is a public-API write/read of a 64x32 DWAA float A image; AddressSanitizer aborts on the patched library (rc 134) and the same binary succeeds against the parent library.
